title: Election Commission Integrity Bill Democratic Quality Scorecard

dimensions.evidence: Protects fundamental right to adult suffrage and non-exclusion from voter rolls
Equal removal protection for ECs and non-discriminatory voter roll access
7-14 yrs imprisonment for CEC/ECs/officers colluding in electoral fraud or voter deletion
Eliminates executive dominance over ECI appointments via independent PM+LOP+CJI panel
100% VVPAT paper slip count and public GIS voter deletion portal
Physical paper slip count legally overrides EVM electronic count in discrepancy
Option for paper ballot voting at every polling station
Voter right to inspect proposed deletion on public GIS portal and appeal to District Judge
